item.title: Solana Co-Founder Amplifies CLARITY Act Calls Ahead of Senate Vote
item.summary: Solana co-founder Anatoly Yakovenko reposted calls from Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong and Senator Cynthia Lummis urging the Senate to pass the CLARITY Act, whose proponents describe as bipartisan, though only Republican senators were identified as supporters in available sources and the underlying 70% polling claim remains Armstrong's unverified assertion.
